claims.text: Property valuers in Australia are regulated through a dual structure: state and territory statutory registration/licensing authorities (Queensland and Western Australia retain statutory registration and codes of conduct; NSW repealed the Valuers Act 2003 in 2016, replacing 'registered valuer' with 'suitably qualified valuer' = API CPV/AVI or RICS) operating alongside the Australian Property Institute's non-statutory Certified Practising Valuer (CPV) designation, nationally recognised. Valuations relied on in regulated consumer credit also engage the National Consumer Credit Protection Act 2009 (ASIC).

sources.publisher: Australian Property Institute / state valuation authorities
sources.title: Valuers Registration & Licensing (dual statutory + CPV scheme)
sources.whatItMeasured: State statutory registration/licensing regimes + API Certified Practising Valuer (CPV) scheme; NCCP Act 2009 where valuations inform consumer credit.

claims.scope: Australian property valuers nationally; binds who may give a valuation opinion. AI/automated valuation models are an emerging edge not yet separately licensed.
claims.refuteNotes: Industry/regulator source describes the dual structure; population = AU property valuers; in force.

claims.text: Jobs and Skills Australia's Generative AI Capacity Study (August 2025) scores 358 ANZSCO occupations on task-level augmentability and automatability. It finds augmentation outweighs automation across the workforce: about 79% of Australian workers face low or very low automation risk, while routine clerical and administrative roles - including bookkeepers, receptionists, and business-analysis, sales, marketing and PR positions - carry the highest automation exposure. The study flags entry-level and clerical business roles as most exposed, with limited mobility options.

sources.title: Australia's AI Transition: Jobs, Skills and the Future of Work (Generative AI Capacity Study)
sources.whatItMeasured: JSA Gen AI Capacity Study, task-level ANZSCO v1.3 exposure, 358 occupations, Aug 2025.

claims.scope: Australian occupations nationally; model-derived task-level estimates. Valuers are professional/skill-level 1-2 roles with high augmentation potential per JSA.
claims.refuteNotes: Primary Australian government source; population = AU occupations; Aug 2025.
